journey: dashboard document list -> authorized download -> repository upload -> persisted canonical row -> download audit -> UI refresh

canonicalContractGaps.detail: No canonical share, member disclosure, export, or WorkAid counsel route. The console fails closed. Do not implement sharing as a privacy-label PATCH.
No canonical retention-execute or legal-hold release mutation. The console no longer rewrites privacy labels for those actions.

appendMandatoryAudit returns false when UE_CANONICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V2 is not 1. The download route withholds a URL when that call throws, and still returns the URL when the helper returns false, matching the published helper. A durable audit row is written when V2 is on.
